name: Kusakabe Satoru
source:
Most of the time an unreliable guy, but he gets serious when it comes his family.
He goes to the same school as his sisters and is part of the baseball club.

[spoiler]He starts dating Ami, but they fight a lot.[/spoiler]
translation:
Most of the time an unreliable guy, but he gets serious when it comes his family.
He goes to the same school as his sisters and is part of the baseball club.

[spoiler]He starts dating Ami, but they fight a lot.[/spoiler]
